mapper.select: SELECT tpd.TRADE_ID as tradeId, PP.PORTFOLIO_ID as portfolioIdOut, ptrd.BACK_LEND_DIRECTION as ps, ftp.BASIS as basis, tpd.TRADE_DATE as tradeDate, ftp.VDATE as vdate, ftp.MDATE as mdate, ftp.CALENDAR_ID as calendarId, tpd.CCY as ccy, ftp.PRIN as prin, nvl(ftp.INT_RATE * 100, 0) as intRate, fpt.TYPE_6 as paBussType FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD tpda ON tpda.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt ON fpt.FINPROD_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID and fpt.BRANCH = 0 LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL ptrd ON ptrd.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT ftp ON ftp.FINPROD_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID and ftp.BRANCH = 0 LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE PT ON tpd.TRADE_ID = PT.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON PT.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE PP.INVEST_YESORNO = #{YESORNO_Y} AND tpd.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} AND tpd.IS_CANCEL != #{YESORNO_Y} AND tpd.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS_01}

SELECT DISTINCT PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID id, PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID || ':' || PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_NAME text FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO LEFT JOIN PTL_CAPACCT_INFO ON PTL_CAPACCT_INFO.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID
INVEST_YESORNO = 'Y' AND PORTFOLIO_TYPE = #{PORTFOLIO_TYPE_01} AND PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID != #{portfolioIdOut} AND PTL_CAPACCT_INFO.ACCT_NO = (SELECT DISTINCT PCI.ACCT_NO FROM PTL_CAPACCT_INFO PCI WHERE PCI.ACCT_TYPE = #{ACCT_TYPE_A01} AND PCI.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioIdOut})
AND (PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') OR PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%'))
AND PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{initValue}
AND PTL_PORTFOLIO.MDATE > to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
